process_area.title: Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics

value_stream.name: Captive Insurance, Reinsurance & Enterprise Risk Financing

fields.Volume: Claims across in-scope captive programs (property/cat, liability, fleet, cyber)

Automation Opportunity: - Claims-administration system; TPA SLA dashboards; loss-data capture automation
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: claims handled per VS-26.3 standard; TPA SLA-monitored (W4534); settlements within authority; reserves updated (W4542)
Cross-references: - links to VS-26.3 (claims), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-17 (finance), W4534 (TPA), W4542 (reserves), W4546 (reinsurance recovery)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Claims-quality risk**: Poor TPA handling → claimant harm/litigation; mitigated by TPA SLA & oversight (W4534)
- **Authority-breach risk**: Settlement beyond authority; mitigated by authority schedule & escalation
System Touchpoints: - Claims (VS-26.3); legal (VS-100.3); finance/GL (VS-17); cyber (VS-27.3); reserves (W4542); loss data (W4551)
Time Estimate: - Per claim lifecycle; large claims months+

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / Insurance Manager
steps.activity: TPA/Insurance administer captive claims (FNOL, investigation, adjustment, settlement) per the commercial claims process (VS-26.3), routing captive-layer claims to the captive

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / Captive Board
steps.activity: Risk/Legal manage large/complex captive claims (cat, liability litigation VS-100, cyber VS-27.3), and approve settlements within authority

steps.a: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Finance/TPA pay claims from captive funds, record loss data (W4551), update reserves (W4542), and trigger reinsurance recovery (W4546) above retention

Automation Opportunity: - Bordereaux/recovery automation; reinsurer-collectible aging; recoverable-on-balance dashboards
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: recoveries submitted per treaty (W4540); reinsurers security-monitored; collectibles reconciled & aged
Cross-references: - links to W4540 (reinsurance), VS-18 (treasury), VS-17 (finance), W4545 (claims), W4534 (broker)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reinsurer-default risk**: Reinsurer fails to pay a cat recovery; mitigated by security-approved reinsurers (W4540) & monitoring
- **Reconcile-error risk**: Recoveries ≠ submissions; mitigated by bordereaux reconciliation

steps.activity: Risk/Broker report losses/bordereaux to reinsurers per treaty (W4540), and submit reinsurance recovery claims above the captive retention
Treasury/Finance collect reinsurance recoveries from reinsurers, reconcile to submissions, and pursue overdue/aged balances

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / Captive Board
steps.activity: Actuarial/Risk monitor reinsurance recoverable on the balance sheet, assess reinsurer default risk, and report collection health to the captive board

fields.Volume: Captive books + statutory statements + group consolidation

Automation Opportunity: - Statutory-statement automation; consolidation/elimination integration (VS-17); intercompany settlement (VS-72)
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: captive books statutory & PFRS-compliant (VS-17); consolidated/eliminated (W4535); board & regulator-reported
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (finance), VS-79 (tax), VS-18 (treasury), W4535 (intercompany), W4542 (reserves), W4548 (regulatory)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Statutory-vs-GAAP-divergence risk**: Different bases confuse; mitigated by clear reconciliation schedule
- **Consolidation-error risk**: Captive mis-eliminated in group; mitigated by intercompany discipline (W4535)

steps.activity: Finance maintain captive books (premium, losses/reserves W4542, reinsurance W4546, investment W4550, expenses) per statutory accounting (domicile) & PFRS (group VS-17)
Finance/Tax prepare statutory statements (domicile) and the group consolidation/elimination of the captive (VS-17/W4535), with intercompany settlement
Captive Board/CFO report captive financials to the group board (VS-36), regulators (W4548), and stakeholders, with management discussion

fields.Trigger: Regulatory cycle; capital event; rule change

workflows.name: Captive Regulatory Compliance, RBC & Domicile Filings

Automation Opportunity: - RBC/capital-adequacy monitoring; regulatory-calendar/filing tracker; examination-evidence pack
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: RBC maintained above required; domicile filings on time (calendar); examinations managed (VS-22)
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-17 (finance), VS-79 (tax), W4533 (governance), W4547 (finance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **RBC-breach risk**: Capital below required → regulatory action; mitigated by RBC monitoring & capital actions
- **Filing-lapse risk**: Missed domicile filing → penalty/license risk; mitigated by regulatory calendar
System Touchpoints: - Compliance (VS-22); legal (VS-100.3); finance (VS-17); tax (VS-79); captive governance (W4533)

steps.activity: Compliance/Finance monitor & maintain RBC/capital adequacy (domicile risk-based capital) for the captive, with capital actions if below required
Compliance/Legal manage domicile filings (annual statement, business-plan changes, material transactions, related-party) and the regulatory calendar
Compliance/Legal manage examinations/regulator inquiries, PH-side treatment (VS-79/VS-22), and report compliance status to the board (VS-36)

fields.Participants: External auditor, Appointed actuary, Finance (VS-17), Compliance (VS-22)
fields.Volume: Captive external audit + actuarial opinion + independent review

workflows.name: Captive Audit, Actuarial Opinion & External Review

Automation Opportunity: - Audit-evidence/finding management; reserve-adequacy support; actuarial-opinion document workflow
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: captive externally audited (VS-21); actuarial opinion obtained; findings remediated & board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-17 (finance), W4542 (reserves), VS-22 (compliance), W4533 (governance), W4548 (regulatory)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Adverse-opinion risk**: Actuarial/audit adverse finding → regulatory/reputational impact; mitigated by prior remediation & reserve adequacy (W4542)
- **Finding-backlog risk**: Unremediated findings; mitigated by tracking & board oversight
System Touchpoints: - Audit (VS-21); finance (VS-17); reserves (W4542); compliance (VS-22); captive governance (W4533)

steps.activity: Audit/Finance run the captive external audit (statutory financial statements, controls), integrated to the group audit (VS-21)
Appointed Actuary issues the actuarial opinion on reserve adequacy (W4542) per domicile requirement, with the statement of actuarial opinion

steps.a: Captive Board Audit Committee / Group Board
steps.activity: Captive Board/Head of Internal Audit & Risk act on audit/actuarial findings, report to the group board/audit committee (VS-36), and remediate issues
steps.r: Captive Board / Head of Internal Audit & Risk / Audit

fields.Trigger: Investment cycle (W4533); liquidity need; treasury review

Automation Opportunity: - Portfolio/ALM analytics; liquidity-stress dashboards; investment-manager performance tracking
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: investments per W4533 policy (ALM/safety/liquidity); claims-paying liquidity maintained; capital actions board-governed
Cross-references: - links to VS-18 (treasury), VS-17 (finance), VS-21.2/W4543 (liquidity), W4533 (policy), W4544 (capital return)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Investment-loss risk**: Portfolio losses impair capital; mitigated by conservative permitted-asset policy
- **Liquidity-mismatch risk**: Investments can't meet sudden claims; mitigated by ALM & liquidity buffer (W4533)

steps.activity: Treasury/Investment Committee manage the captive investment portfolio per the W4533 policy (ALM, liquidity for claims W4545, safety, yield), with permitted-asset discipline
Treasury/Finance manage captive cash/liquidity (claims-paying readiness, cat-liquidity W4543), rebalance, and report portfolio performance
Captive Board/Treasury manage capital actions (capital injection, dividend/capital return W4544), investment-manager oversight, and report to the board (VS-36)

workflows.name: Captive Loss Data, Analytics & Risk-Financing Intelligence

Automation Opportunity: - Loss-data warehouse; trend/severity analytics; loss-prevention recommendation engine
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: loss data quality-governed (VS-28); analytics feed pricing/reserving/ERM (W4538/W4542/VS-21.2); insights actioned
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (data), W4545 (claims), VS-21.2 (ERM), VS-23/VS-24/VS-27.3 (loss prevention), W4538/W4542 (pricing/reserving)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Poor loss data → bad pricing/reserving; mitigated by data governance (VS-28)
- **Insight-not-actioned risk**: Analytics unused; mitigated by loss→mitigation→premium loop

steps.activity: Actuarial/Data capture & warehouse captive loss data (claims W4545, exposure, development) with quality/consistency, feeding reserving (W4542) & pricing (W4538)
Actuarial/BI analyze loss trends/frequency/severity by line/entity/cause, feeding ERM (VS-21.2) and loss-prevention (VS-23/VS-24/VS-27.3) actions

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / CFO / Board
steps.activity: Risk/Finance close the loop (loss insight → risk-mitigation → lower loss → lower premium), and report risk-financing intelligence to the board (VS-36)

fields.Owner: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk / Captive Board / Strategy (VS-33)

workflows.name: Captive Performance Review, Run-Off & Strategic Options

Automation Opportunity: - Performance-vs-baseline dashboards; strategic-options modeling; run-off/commutation valuation
Controls: - CTL-691 (ensure controlled execution — Captive Claims, Finance, Regulatory & Portfolio Analytics (PA-153.3).)
- CTL-691: captive performance reviewed vs success metrics (W4529); strategic-options assessed; wind-down via VS-130/M&A discipline if chosen
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-21.2 (risk), VS-18 (treasury), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-130 (M&A), W4529 (business case), W4541 (commutation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sunk-cost bias**: Persisting with an underperforming captive; mitigated by success-metric review & options assessment
- **Run-off-complexity risk**: Wind-down leaves long-tail liabilities; mitigated by commutation/run-off planning (W4541) & legal rigor
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (VS-33); risk (VS-21.2); treasury (VS-18); legal (VS-100.3); M&A (VS-130); captive governance (W4533)

steps.activity: CFO/Head of Internal Audit & Risk/Strategy review captive performance vs the W4529 business-case success metrics (cost-of-risk reduction, combined ratio, capital efficiency), and the strategic rationale
steps.r: CFO / Head of Internal Audit & Risk / Strategy

steps.activity: CFO/Strategy/Captive Board evaluate strategic options (continue/expand, restructure scope, run-off/commute, redomesticate, divest) if performance/rationale changes
Captive Board/CFO execute the chosen path (expand W4530, run-off W4541 commutation, or wind-down via VS-130/M&A-type transaction), reporting to the board (VS-36)
